messages:
marta: Quick note: sampleapp's curl example produces different output than the Node SDK. Optional params are dropped.
chris: repro steps?
marta: curl: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-1\",\"prompt\":\"hey\",\"preserve_format\":true,\"metadata\":{\"src\":\"quickstart\"}}'`
chris: SDK: `client.generate({ model: 'rwd-1', prompt: 'hey', preserveFormat: true, metadata: { src: 'quickstart' } })`
sam: SDK sends camelCase keys; new batching proto expects snake_case so fields are ignored.
priya: confirmed. batching-layer proto canonicalized to snake_case (BUILD-1234). I'll add a runtime shim that accepts both shapes and emits metric `sdk_param_normalization_mismatch`.
marta: I'll open the SDK PR to normalize known keys -> snake_case and update quickstart snippets.
chris: add regression test asserting REST vs SDK output hash parity.
marta: PR will include a mapping util, unit tests, and README snippet showing snake_case examples.
deploy-bot: BUILD-1234: batching-layer proto change merged 2026-03-18T04:22:11Z.
